onboarding.title: Select your island
onboarding.subtitle: Prayer times are published per island in the Maldives. Pick yours to get started.
onboarding.tagline: Prayer times, Qibla direction, and the Hijri calendar - built for every island in the Maldives.
onboarding.feature1: Accurate prayer times for your island
onboarding.feature2: Find the Qibla direction, wherever you are
onboarding.feature3: Track the Hijri calendar and notable Islamic dates

qibla.title: Qibla direction
qibla.instructions: Hold your phone flat and rotate until the arrow points up.
qibla.permissionDenied: Compass access was denied. Enable motion & orientation access in Settings to use the Qibla finder.
qibla.calibrate: Compass needs calibration. Move your phone in a figure-8 motion.

settings.title: Settings
settings.notificationsSubtitle: Choose which prayers send you a reminder
settings.silentModeNote: The adhan sound won't play if your phone's Ring/Silent switch is set to silent - that's an iOS restriction, not an app setting. You'll still get the notification and vibration.
settings.qiblaHapticsSubtitle: This is an app setting - it doesn't change your device's system haptics.
settings.testNotificationsSubtitle: Fires one real notification a few seconds from now with the adhan sound, so you can check it on the lock screen or in the background.
settings.testAdhanScheduled: Scheduled - lock your phone or switch apps to hear it.
settings.testAdhanBody: This is a test notification using the adhan sound.
